title: Easy American Chicken Casserole
description: A classic American casserole with a French twist, featuring tender chicken and a creamy sauce.
instructions: Cook chicken breasts in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned on both sides and cooked through.
In a separate skillet, sauté the French-fried onions in butter until golden brown.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cream of mushroom soup, shredded cheddar cheese, and cooked chicken. Stir until well combined.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, arrange a layer of the chicken mixture.
Sprinkle a layer of French-fried onions on top of the chicken mixture.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of French-fried onions on top.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the onions are golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
